## P117 — rejected, unfinished checkpoint; DO NOT MERGE

Head 7202c7279606cc920566f8649c80939e071191cf preserves the full source migration for takeover. P117 was taken away in message 17543. No further implementation by this author after that instruction.

Thread and ThreadProvenance now store runtime: RuntimeLocation. The old session_file field, Thread.require_saved_session, Thread.native_transcripts and PiSessionFile.of reader are deleted. Thread.backend derives from the location. Transcript cursors/read identities carry RuntimeLocation, and history acquisition goes through history_source on its owning location. Native private path arguments were migrated to source_path. Native storage lifecycle and model observation moved to PiSessionFile; new-session construction moved to PiNativeBackend.

### Rejected design — still present

The migration wrongly rebuilt optionality as RuntimeLocation.available, __bool__, path-if-available ternaries, an empty read_key sentinel, and history_source(None, None). These must be removed. Saved/unstarted members must own their differing send, history, registration and read-ledger behavior; callers must not recover the distinction through flags or sentinels. Do not merge or install this checkpoint.

### Exact state

- Source versus b5000b3b0: 37 files, +334/-244, net +90. Net-negative requirement NOT met.
- Matching session_file source lines: 254 before, 101 after.
- Requested check for transcripts.py/native_pi.py: zero matching files.
- One-shot carrier tools/cutover/thread_runtime_location.py is provisional and has NOT been applied to the active registry or deleted. It must be reviewed, applied at quiet cutover, and deleted before merge. Do not run it against the active old-codec runtime.
- P118 #1127 has NOT been merged. Its frozen head is b1fa2b97f0ccd79d3b24feef26520dbda3a7f1e8.

### Verification

48 passed, 2 failed across backend, transcript paging/read identity/lifetime/routes, native transcript and external transcript checks. Both failures reproduce unchanged against b5000b3b0: malformed-entry strict decoding and the ancestry-walk assertion. Logs: .artifacts/p117/owner-consumers-final.log and baseline-two-checks.log.

A real saved thread was carried IN MEMORY, decoded through the new Thread codec, and 12 bounded native history records were read. Original registry bytes were not modified; no input was sent. This is NOT Xvfb/st UI acceptance or provider-reply acceptance.

NRA before/after boundary checkpoint inventories parsed 1065 modules with zero omissions. The later broad consumer migration needs its final inventory refresh; the earlier after-ast artifact predates that batch. Dynamic callbacks/lazy registry/MRO resolution are not proved by AST.

All work is published, with a clean tracked checkout. Original saved sessions, UNKNOWN inputs and installed runtime pointers are untouched. Retained local evidence lives under .artifacts/p117; the baseline source archive there is disposable after takeover/comparison acceptance.
title: WIP P117: runtime-location ownership and backend delivery contract
